sources.author_creator: War Department; National Archives and Records Administration

sources.title: World War II Army Enlistment Records: Reference Copy of Technical Documentation
sources.locator: Reference-copy pages 40-42 define fixed-width identifier, name, Army-entry-date, grade, and civilian-occupation fields; user notes describe merged-file limitations
sources.collection_name: Army Serial Number Electronic Files technical documentation
sources.rights_notes: The documentation warns that the merged file includes transcription errors, duplicate identifiers, missing ranges, and no officer records.

sources.title: NARA Compiled Code Lists for the Electronic Army Serial Number Merged File
sources.author_creator: War Department; National Archives and Records Administration
sources.locator: Compiled civilian occupation list; codes 097, 316, and 736 visually checked; code 999 left uninterpreted
sources.collection_name: Army Serial Number Electronic Files code documentation
sources.rights_notes: The three-digit category describes an occupation at Army entry, not a named employer, workplace, exact duties, or immediate Army-to-OSS chronology. Code 999 is not assigned a public meaning.
